SOC

साक्ष्य संग्रहण

The systematic process of gathering digital artifacts, logs, devices, or other data relevant to a security incident, following forensic best practices to preserve integrity.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, MITRE ATT&CK and published by Protermify Cybersecurity as a static cybersecurity reference page.

Definition

The systematic process of gathering digital artifacts, logs, devices, or other data relevant to a security incident, following forensic best practices to preserve integrity.

Operational example

Proper evidence collection techniques prevent data contamination and ensure that digital evidence is admissible in both internal investigations and court proceedings.
